item.title: Show HN: Chroncal – A TUI for Calendar
item.summary: I've been working on Chroncal for the past weeks, an open source TUI/CLI with iCalendar (RFC 5545) support and CalDAV sync, using SQLite to store the data. My main goal is to make it easy for LLMs to auto-discover the CLI commands and access the database, while providing a nice TUI for the user (and I also found it paired very well with Omarchy, so, I also made a plugin to integrate in on Quickshell: https://github.com/DouglasdeMoura/chroncal-bar ). I'd love some feeback, specially to find bugs and missing features you find important. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49453176 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
